The plate is about 26 cm across, which is roughly 360 px in the image, so about 14 px per cm.

The sausage is about 190 px long and 55 px wide, which is roughly 13.5 cm by 4 cm. That looks like a single link, about 80-90 g. At roughly 250 kcal per 100 g, that is about 200 kcal.

I count about 8 roasted Brussels sprouts, some whole and some halved, each around 15-20 g. That comes to about 130 g. Roasted with oil, they are roughly 90 kcal per 100 g, or about 120 kcal total.

Together the food weighs about 215 g and comes to about 320 kcal.
